rapport_notes: Excellent emotional handling of a downsizing/divorce-adjacent situation ('we're selling a lot of our furniture') with genuine validation across several turns.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before we proceed may I also have, if you have any important concerns or stressors that you want us to discuss over the phone as well." — asked immediately, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised real uncertainty about what furniture would even be moving (much being sold); rep worked through this across multiple exchanges — confirming what's staying vs. going, and again later confirming the list was actually settled — before proposing the walkthrough.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "If we go over that we only charge in every fifteen minutes until the move is complete."

top_strength: Recognized the inventory was too fluid for an accurate quote and cleanly routed to a virtual walkthrough instead of guessing a number — protects the estimate-accuracy goal.
coaching_note: Add the actual value-trade half of the quid-pro-quo ("a few questions, then I can get you a personalized estimate") — she asked permission but never stated what the customer gets in return.
